reviews.title: An Exceptional App!
reviews.text: I've been using this EXCELLENT app since 2017, and it never ceases to amaze me and to keep improving with time. If you use the Apple Contacts app AND Gmail, then you need this app to help keep all of your email addresses up to date whenever you update one in your Apple Contacts, since it won't automatically update at Google without this app. The owner/manager, Donald, provides superb customer service. And while you're at it, sign up for the Lifetime subscription which for some odd reason is priced the same as a 1-year subscription! But most importantly, subscribe. You won't be disappointed.
